verses.text: Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' soldado filisteo yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel. Ix yalan winhaj Aquis chi' t'a winhaj David icha tik: --Ha ach tik yowalil ol ach b'at wet' t'a owal yet' heb' ajun et'ok, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj David chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab'ta' mamin rey, a tiknaik ol ila' tastak syal wuuj a in a chekab' in tik, xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a winhaj David chi': --Tzach wak'kanoch in tanhwumalok t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', chamnakxo winhaj Samuel, masanil heb' israel ok'nak yuj winh. Ha t'a Ramá schonhab' winh, ata' mukb'il winh. Axo winhaj Saúl spechnakel heb' ajchum winh yet' heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak t'a skal chonhab' Israel chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo chi', ix b'at heb' sb'ok'e skampamento t'a Sunem. Anheja' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' israel winhaj Saúl t'a Gilboa.
Ayik ix yilanb'at skampamento heb' filisteo winhaj Saúl chi', ix somchaj spensar winh, ix xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová, palta maj tak'woklaj t'a winh t'a wayichal, ma t'a heb' sakerdote, ma t'a heb' schekab' Dios.

Ayik ix yilan winh to chuk yaji, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab' icha tik: --Sayek junok ix ix syal sk'uman spixan chamnak, yik wach' ha t'a ix ol in k'anb'ej in b'a, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh ay yopisio yet' winh: --Ha t'a Endor, ay jun ix syal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak chi', xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Ix sk'exanel spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik sreyal, haxo yik heb' komon anima ix yak'och winh. Ix yik'anb'at chawanhxo soldado winh yet'ok, ix b'at winh t'ak'walil yik sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a winh t'a jun ix ix chi', ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to in gana tzawtej spixan jun mach ol wal tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --Ojtak tas ix utaj heb' ajchum yuj winhaj Saúl yet' heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, ix pechjiel heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik yuj winh. ¿Tas yuj tza say tas tz'aji yik tzin miljichamok? xchi ix.
Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Saúl chi': --Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to malaj tas ol ach ik'anok, xchi winh.
--¿Mach b'an jun ol wawtej chi' alani? xchi ix. --Haton spixan winhaj Samuel chamnakxo tzawtej in k'ana', xchi winh.
T'a wal jun rato chi' ix yilan winhaj Samuel jun ix ix chi', te chaanh ix el yaw ix yuj xiwelal, ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi':

--¿Tas yuj tzin ak' musansatil? Tob'an a ach Saúl ach, xchi ix t'a winh. --Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi' icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok, ¿tas jun ix il chi'? xchi winh. --Ay jun pixan chamnak swil sk'eul t'a yol lu'um, xchi ix.

--¿Chajtil yilji? xchi winh. --Ha jun winh winak te ichamxo, ay jun k'apak spichul winh te jukan ayoch yuj, xchi ix. Ix snaanel winh to a winhaj Samuel ix sch'ox sb'a, yuj chi' ix em nhojan winh t'a sat lu'um.

Ix yalan winhaj Samuel chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj tzin ixtej, tzin awtankoti? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Saúl chi': --Ix ach wawtej yik tzal t'ayin tas tzin k'ulej, yujto te xiwnak in, ayxo ek' heb' filisteo yak' owal wet'ok, manhxo ayokochlaj Dios wet'ok, maxtzak tak'wilaj t'a tas swala', manhxo jab'ok stak'wi ayik tzin k'anb'an t'a heb' schekab', wach'chom t'a wayichal, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Samuel chi' icha tik: --Tato max tak'wi Jehová chi' t'ayach, ¿tas yuj a t'ayin tza k'anb'ej? Yujto toxo ix och Jehová ajk'olal t'ayach, yuj chi' ix ach yaktejkani.
Wanxo yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová wal t'ayach to toxo ix yik'ek' opisio t'a reyal, haxo t'a winhaj David ix yak'kani.
Yujto maj a k'anab'ajej a satanel heb' amalekita ayik yalan Jehová t'ayach, yuj chi' ix ach yaktejkani.

Manhoknhej chi', palta to ol ach yak'och Jehová yet' pax heb' a soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' a k'ik'an tzach cham yet' heb' uninal, tzach jawi t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak b'aj ayinek' tik, yujto a Jehová ol ach ak'anoch yet' heb' a soldado t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo chi', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Saúl chi' icha chi', ix telwi winh, ix b'at wal lian winh t'a sat lu'um. Ix te xiw winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Samuel chi'. Ix te el yip winh yujto maj walaj winh t'a jun k'u chi' yet' t'a jun ak'wal yik ix b'at winh t'a yoltak b'e.

Yuj chi' ayik ix yilan jun ix ix chi' to ix te somchaj spensar winh, ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winh, ix yalan ix: --Ha in a chekab' in tik masanil tas ix ala' ix in k'anab'ajej, wach'chom ay smay in cham yuj tas ix in k'ulej tik.
Yuj chi' ab' tas swal tik: Ol wak' jab'ok tas ol a wa''a yik wach' ol ochxok jab'ok ip tzach b'ati, xchi ix t'a winh.

Maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix wa'i, palta haxo heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok yet' jun ix ix chi', a heb' ix ak'an pural winh swa'i. Ichato chi' ix k'e wan winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a sti' jun ch'at.
Yakb'an chi' ix smilancham jun nok' yune' wakax ix te b'ak'uech, ix sb'oan nok' ix yet' pax ixim pan malaj yich.
Ix yik'anb'at wael chi' ix t'a winhaj Saúl chi' yet' t'a heb' winh schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix lajwi swa heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh.
